# The Original Maids of Honour

> A Historic Traditional English Tearoom Shop and Bakery at 288 Kew Road, Richmond.

Preview note: this file belongs to a speculative design proposal by an independent studio. It is not the official The Original Maids of Honour website and is not commissioned or endorsed by The Original Maids of Honour. The official website is https://theoriginalmaidsofhonour.co.uk/.

## Visit

- Address: 288 Kew Road, Richmond, Surrey, TW9 3DU
- Phone: 020 8940 2752
- Email: admin@theoriginalmaidsofhonour.co.uk
- Opening hours: every day, 9am to 6pm. Whether the shop and tearoom keep different hours, and bank holiday and Christmas hours, are to be confirmed.
- Luncheon: Monday to Sunday, 12pm to 3pm.
- Set teas: sittings all day, Monday to Sunday. High Tea, Savoury High Tea and The Special Set Tea from 10am; Prosecco and Champagne teas from 11am.
- Walk-ins: "Tables are available throughout the day on a first-come, first-served basis." Last walk-ins must be seated by 17:30.

## Menus

- [Menus](menu.html): breakfast, luncheon, the set teas, the Patisserie List and drinks, from the tearoom's 2024 menus. Prices may have changed (to be confirmed).
- Service: "Service is not included in menu prices. A discretionary service charge of 12.5% will be added to bill."
